description: Na₃DyCl₆ is Ilmenite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Cl¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.82-3.13 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Cl¹⁻ atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent DyCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-46°. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.72-2.86 Å. Dy³⁺ is bonded to six Cl¹⁻ atoms to form DyCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-46°. There are a spread of Dy-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.61-2.65 Å. There are three inequivalent Cl¹⁻ sites. In the first Cl¹⁻ site, Cl¹⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and one Dy³⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ClNa₃Dy trigonal pyramids. In the second Cl¹⁻ site, Cl¹⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and one Dy³⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ClNa₃Dy trigonal pyramids. In the third Cl¹⁻ site, Cl¹⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and one Dy³⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ClNa₃Dy trigonal pyramids.
